core.title: Clear Acrylic Cabinet Knob, RK International CK-1AC

text.description_html:
RK International 1AC, Clear Melon Cabinet Door Knob

There is something to be said about the beauty of a clear cabinet knob as it reflects the light of the room around it. RK International makes this Melon Cabinet Door Knob out of acrylic for durability and clarity. The 1AC Clear Acrylic Cabinet Knob is available with your choice of four rosette finishes: polished brass, oil rubbed bronze, satin nickel, and polished chrome. Each of these beautiful finishes brings its own character to the knob; but it is the melon styling that brings this cabinet hardware to life. It is a perfect rendition of classic elegance for a modern space. Plus, it comes packaged with installation hardware.

Specifications and Features of the 1AC Clear Acrylic Cabinet Door Knob:

  • Material: acrylic with a brass rose
  • Diameter: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
